license.name: Connecticut Restroom Specialties (CRS)
license.registry: City of Newark building contractor licensing (Ordinance 8:21-1); also checked Connecticut DCP State Licenses and Credentials open data (data.ct.gov ngch-56tr) and CT Business Registry (data.ct.gov n7gp-d28j)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Newark's Building Contractor page returned HTTP 403 to automated access and Newark publishes no public contractor lookup we could reach, so the city license could not be checked online; confirm with Newark business licensing. New Jersey has no state license for commercial installers (NJ HIC registration is residential only). Connecticut has no state license for commercial partition work. In the official CT license data, no record was found under 'Connecticut Restroom Specialties' or any name containing 'RESTROOM' (the Danbury 'CRS' records found, CRS Group LLC HIC.0606968 inactive and CRS Painting LLC HIC.0656774, are unrelated businesses). The CT business registry open data also has no entity with 'Restroom Specialt' in the name, so the legal entity name is unknown. The company site (https://www.ctrestroom.com/) says it is based in Danbury, CT, phone 203-205-0170, does commercial restroom work (offices, schools, restaurants, retail, government buildings) and says 'We are fully licensed and insured' without giving any license number. Ask them for their legal entity name and Newark license if they take Newark jobs.
